subject: Urgent: Cross-region traffic siphon & integrity check for NovaSystems
messages:
From: Lena Ortiz <lena@novasystems.com>
To: support@redwood.ai, connor.obrien@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-07-20T01:15:00Z
Subject: Production latency + 502 spike — us-west-2

Hi team,

We started seeing a sustained p95 latency jump (~1.8s) on our prod inference route and a brief 502 surge between 00:58–01:04 UTC that coincided with a throughput drop. This is impacting time-sensitive features for our customers.

What we observed:
- p50 ~120ms but p95 up to ~1.8s for three consecutive 1-min windows
- 502 spike: ~6 minutes, peaked at 8% of requests
- Overall qps down ~18% during the spike

We've confirmed no config change on our side. Can Redwood perform an immediate cross-region siphon of a percentage of traffic to use-east-1 while you investigate origin of the 502s in us-west-2? We need:
1) temporary traffic siphon (conservative) and confirmation of circuit integrity
2) expected timeline for mitigation and monitoring link
3) how this will affect routing stability and cache warmup

Attached: request-20280720-logs.tar.gz (server side traces + timestamps).

We're available on Slack if faster. Please advise next steps and an ETA — this is high impact for our monitoring.

Thanks,
Lena Ortiz
Head of Platform Engineering
NovaSystems

---

From: connor.obrien@redwood.ai
To: hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai, vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: lena@novasystems.com, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-07-20T01:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Production latency + 502 spike — us-west-2

Acknowledged — looping in routing and reliability. Initial plan (short):
1) Apply conservative cross-region siphon: target 12–15% -> use-east-1. Aim is to relieve hot AZ hot-path while keeping steady katana checks.
2) Warm prefix cache on the siphoned path and enable stricter 5xx rollback thresholds.
3) Run quick KV cache health check and telemetry collection (Hannah will run).
4) Share live dashboard link and incident notes with the customer; escalate to exec if stability not restored in 30 minutes.

Hannah / Vanessa — please confirm the siphon window, expected rollback criteria, and post-siphon validation steps. Marissa, I'm CCing you for potential customer credit request if this meets the billing criteria.

Connor O'Brien
Account Lead, Redwood Inference

---

From: hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai
To: connor.obrien@redwood.ai, vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: lena@novasystems.com
Date: 2028-07-20T01:35:00Z
Subject: Re: Production latency + 502 spike — us-west-2

On it. Quick technical notes:
- I pulled the request-level traces from the attached logs; signatures indicate an increased queueing time in the regional ingress path before our routing layer (likely an AZ-internal transient).
- Steps I'll run immediately:
  * kvcache-health-check --target=us-west-2 --window=5m
  * enable-shadow-siphon --percent=12 --to=use-east-1 --grace=60s
  * set-rollback-thresholds --5xx=3% --latency-p95=1500ms

Estimated effect: siphoning 12% should reduce effective qps on affected nodes by ~13–15% and lower p95 by ~20–30% within 90s of warmup. We'll keep the siphon in place until steady-state for 20m, then reassess.

Attaching: routing-policy-20280720.json (policy used for siphon).

Hannah Schmitt
Staff SRE, Redwood Inference

---

From: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
To: connor.obrien@redwood.ai, hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai
Cc: lena@novasystems.com
Date: 2028-07-20T01:45:15Z
Subject: Re: Production latency + 502 spike — us-west-2

Siphon activated at 01:41 UTC. Current snapshot: siphon=12% -> use-east-1.
Live links: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboard/novasystems/incidents/INC-20280720-21 (live)
Metrics update:
- 01:42 UTC: overall 5xx rate down to 2.1% (from 4.6% pre-siphon)
- 01:44 UTC: p95 latency trending down to ~1.1s
- no route-flaps observed in the last 90s

Validation plan:
- We'll monitor for cache miss amplification; if p95 rises or 5xx >3% for two consecutive mins, we roll back siphon by 50% and notify.
- If stabilization not reached by 02:12 UTC (30m), escalate to VP Eng.

Vanessa Ortiz
Routing Product Ops, Redwood Inference

---

From: Lena Ortiz <lena@novasystems.com>
To: connor.obrien@redwood.ai
Cc: hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai, vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-07-20T02:04:10Z
Subject: Re: Production latency + 502 spike — us-west-2

Thanks — saw the immediate improvement after the siphon. Dashboard looks healthier (p95 down, 5xx within target). We did see a ~6-minute window of user-facing 502s which generated alerts and downstream retries; can we get an estimate for one-time credits for that blast? We'll need documentation for our postmortem.

—Lena
